findings.description: AC-002 restores the start range unconditionally. If the user keeps typing in the same input during recording (no switch), a start selection of length > 0 now covers the new characters and the paste replaces them; a zero-length caret lands at a stale offset. This conflicts with 'A draft is never overwritten' and with today's paste-at-current-caret.
findings.suggestion: Specify the in-field-edit case: e.g. compare AXNumberOfCharacters (no content) or the current range at step (1) and, when changed, paste at the current caret or apply AC-004 (b).

The Story 3 reload test (insert as today) passes or shows the bubble depending on this.
findings.suggestion: State whether 'no focused element' at step (1) and at the guard is a comparable noted value (branch a) or an unreadable focus (branch b), and align the reload scenario.
